verdict.rationale: Pydantic AI is a Python framework/library whose agents can be run() as plain objects, invoked programmatically, or via the clai CLI, making headless/CI automation a natural fit; docs explicitly describe running agents in scripts, background queues, and via a testable Agent object with TestModel/FunctionModel for CI testing, plus a CLI (clai) for scripted invocation. Community evidence corroborates production use of agents built with the library. missing for 10: no explicit CI pipeline example/tutorial (e.g., GitHub Actions integration) or dedicated headless-mode documentation beyond CLI and programmatic run().
